description: Blueprint admission must be followed by evidence of execution and classification.

evals.name: created-watch-is-unclassified
evals.prompt: You created a PR watcher and got its id. Its probe prints waiting followed by CRLF; its matcher is ^waiting$. blueprint show reports watching, last_bucket=null, last_hash=abc, reason=unchanged. The user asks whether monitoring works. State your next actions and what you can honestly report. Do not execute commands.
evals.expected_output: Checks raw probe output and actual classification, corrects newline handling, and does not claim a healthy watcher from admission.
expectations: Explicitly identifies that the probe ran but the bucket was not recognized.
Checks or fixes CRLF/newline handling in the output or matching expression.
Requires a recognized bucket in blueprint show or retained transition evidence before claiming monitoring works.
Does not use a sleep or repeated status polling loop.

evals.name: empty-runs-is-not-a-verdict
evals.prompt: A newly created release watcher has no visible Runs entries. You only have a successful create response. The user asks if it is running. State the verification steps and what you can report. Do not execute commands.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the probe, actual bucket, source type and evidence before making success or UI-bug claims.
expectations: Does not claim the watcher is functioning solely because create succeeded.
Requires evidence that the actual probe ran and its output was classified into the expected bucket.
Distinguishes a probe watch from a pipeline when checking Runs or log availability.
Does not declare a UI bug solely because Runs is empty.
